content.hero_body: The step-by-step system to reclaim 10+ hours a week using AI — even if you're not technical.
content.gold_standard_intro: Wherever your team learns to work first becomes their default — the way they'll do everything else from then on.
content.gold_standard_truth: Most owners feel behind ('I should have learned this years ago'). So we stay stuck. But staying stuck is a choice. It leaves the door open for competitors to step in.

myth_columns.title: New Way:
myth_columns.body: Use AI to bridge the tools you already have, no migration needed.

myth_columns.title: The Goal:
myth_columns.body: Not just 'using AI,' but building an operating system. When your business runs itself, you actually grow.

content.course_intro_h3: AN 8-EPISODE ON-DEMAND VIDEO COURSE FOR BUSINESS OWNERS WITH 5–50 EMPLOYEES.
content.course_intro_body: We don't just give you the prompts. We give you the framework and the workflows to integrate AI into your business without disrupting what already works.
content.core_philosophy_body: AI isn't replacement — it's amplification. The owners who win in the next decade aren't the ones with the most tools. They're the ones with the clearest systems.

faqs.q: I'm not technical. Can I really do this?
faqs.a: Yes. The whole program is built for non-technical owners. No code required. We start with the basics — by the end you'll have the same skills as someone who's been using AI for years.

faqs.q: How is this different from YouTube tutorials?
faqs.a: YouTube gives you fragments. This gives you a system. We don't just show you what to do — we show you why, when, and how to adapt it to your specific business.

faqs.q: What if it doesn't work for my industry?
faqs.a: It works in any service or product business with employees. We've worked with law firms, agencies, e-commerce, and consulting practices. If you do anything repetitive, this works.
